title: Swift Package List Custom Packages v1
description: Legacy custom packages format: an array of package objects without a version field. Associate this schema through editor settings because an array cannot contain a top-level $schema property.

kind.description: The package kind. Known values are localSourceControl, remoteSourceControl, registry and custom; other strings are also supported.

identity.description: The package identity used for filtering and ordering.

name.description: The display name of the package.

revision.description: The source control revision or commit.

location.description: The package location, such as a local path or repository URL. May be empty for registry packages.
